name: Ona Ken! 1.8 - Ushinawareta Acme
original_name: オナけん!1.8 - 失われたアクメ
source:
Fruits JAM's popular Ona-Ken! spinoff #4! 
 The lead voice performance by Nao Kasukabe earns the distinction of "Ona-Ken final boss"! 

 Prologue 
 The other members of Ona-Ken are caught in school events or wiped out by health, 
 leaving Nao alone to indulge her "onani life" in the empty clubroom. 
 But! In a bizarre twist Nao loses the ability to orgasm!
 She asks her health teacher Setsuko "Secchan" Yamino for advice
 but as Secchan listens to Nao's detailed masturbations day after day, 
 it starts to warp her sensibilities... 

 Female characters are fully voiced! 
 CVs: Rizu Sawashiro, Ruka Manome
translation:
Fruits JAM热门作品《自慰研究会！》衍生作第4弹！
春日部奈绪的主力配音让她获得了“自慰研究会最终BOSS”的称号！

序章
自慰研究会的其他成员要么被学校活动缠身，要么因健康问题退场，只剩奈绪在空荡荡的社团活动室里尽情享受“自慰生活”。
但是！在一个荒诞的转折下，奈绪失去了高潮的能力！
她向保健老师山野节子“节姐”寻求建议，然而节姐日复一日听着奈绪详细讲述自慰过程，感受也开始逐渐扭曲……

女性角色全部配音！
配音：泽城里津、间目琉花
